The Transfer Center RN Coordinator is a key member of the UCI Health Capacity Command Center (CCC), responsible for facilitating safe, timely, and appropriate patient access into and across UCI Health enterprise locations. Serving as a primary point of contact for referring facilities, the Transfer Center RN Coordinator combines strong clinical judgment with exceptional communication and customer service to support a responsive and coordinated transfer experience. The incumbent works in partnership with the CCC Medical Director and interdisciplinary teams to facilitate clinical decision-making, appropriate patient placement, and effective use of system capacity. The role requires knowledge of hospital capabilities and scopes of service, the ability to manage multiple priorities and complex clinical situations, and effective communication across referring and receiving teams. Through clinical expertise, collaboration, and service excellence, the RN Coordinator supports continuity of care and the UCI Health Capacity Command Center’s commitment to the right patient, right bed, right location, and right time.
CCM, ACM or Case Management credentialing

Knowledge of University policies and procedures
Must possess the skill, knowledge and ability essential to the successful performance of assigned duties
Must possess complete understanding of acuity levels for specific patient population especially ICU
Must demonstrate excellent customer service skills
Advanced computer literacy and proficiency in MS Office Products (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Access, Teams, Sharepoint) with the ability to run various reports
Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and maintain a work pace appropriate to the workload
Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships across the Health System

Ability to effectively manage high-stress, time-sensitive telephone communications with clinicians, maintain composure and professionalism, and accurately document relevant information and actions in the appropriate systems in a timely manner.
